question: Which dance form of Goa is also known as the ‘Warrior Dance’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghode Modni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Ghode Modini folk** dance holds a prominent place in the **Shigmo festival,** which takes place during the harvest season in **Goa**. 
 
• This traditional dance form is particularly popular in the Talukas regions of Goa, where it is performed in remembrance of the Maratha rule. 
 
• During the Shigmo festivities, spanning 14 days, participants enact movements simulating combat with swords, reflecting the valor of Maratha warriors. 
 
• Accompanied by rhythmic drum beats, dancers synchronize their motions with the swaying of swords, creating a dynamic and spirited performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In Assam,** the Bihu festival **stands as a cornerstone of cultural celebration, cherished by indigenous communities not only in Assam but also across Northeastern India.
 
• **Lavani, **a folk art originating from Maharashtra, blends traditional music and dance, typically accompanied by the vibrant rhythm of the dholki percussion instrument.
 
• **Rouf dance, **a rhythmic expression of Jammu and Kashmir's cultural heritage, is a captivating display predominantly performed by women.
